sv.title: Volvo Bussar tar order på 108 bussar i Peru
sv.summary: Volvo Bussar har fått två order om totalt 108 bussar i Peru. Det framgår av ett pressmeddelande.

en.title: Volvo Buses wins orders for 108 buses in Peru
en.summary: Volvo Buses has received two orders totalling 108 buses in Peru. This is according to a press release.
